scheme_name: Nai Manzil – Education & Skill Development for Minorities
overview: Nai Manzil – Education & Skill Development for Minorities is a Central Sector Scheme launched by the Ministry of Minority Affairs to provide education and skill development to minority youth. It targets school dropouts and those educated in community education institutions like madrasas, offering them formal education (up to Class VIII or X) and skill training in market-relevant trades. The scheme aims to enhance employability and socio-economic upliftment of minority communities through integrated education and vocational training.
objectives: To provide formal education (up to Class VIII or X) to minority youth lacking basic education
To offer skill development training in market-relevant trades for better employability
To integrate education with skill development for holistic upliftment
To target school dropouts and students from community education institutions
To enhance socio-economic conditions of minority communities through certified training
eligibility: The scheme targets minority youth in the age group of 17-35 years who are school dropouts or educated in community education institutions such as madrasas, and belong to notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains).
benefits: Beneficiaries receive free formal education (up to Class VIII or X) and skill training in market-relevant trades, along with a stipend during training, post-placement support, and certification recognized by NCVT or equivalent bodies. The scheme also provides placement assistance and tracking for sustainable livelihoods.
financial_support: The scheme provides 100% financial assistance from the Ministry of Minority Affairs, covering education, skill training, stipend to trainees, and placement support. Funds are disbursed through implementing agencies following General Financial Rules (GFRs).
application_process: 1. Identify eligible minority youth through community mobilization and outreach. 2. Mobilize and counsel target beneficiaries for enrollment. 3. Enroll candidates in designated education and skill training centers. 4. Provide integrated education and vocational training as per NCVT norms. 5. Conduct assessments and issue certifications. 6. Facilitate placement and post-placement tracking for sustainable livelihoods.
required_documents: Age proof (birth certificate or school leaving certificate)
Bank account details for stipend transfer
caveats: Beneficiaries must belong to notified minority communities
Training must be completed to receive certification and placement support
Stipend is provided only during the training period
